svg.title: RAHBAR complete assignment workflow
svg.desc: Windows startup, five-stage indexing, grounded question answering with sessions and cache, protected CI/CD and Kubernetes controls.
svg.text: Jibran: application / RAG • Alishba: platform / delivery • Windows development + Kubernetes workloads
Indexer Job / weekly CronJob — sole writer
API reads the published index; never indexes
PDF / HTML text; OCR scanned pages
Writer lock; create a new generation
Old readers remain available until switch
Save session; cache only safe eligible answers
No provider reasoning in HTTP or application logs
CD: verify merged main SHA again
Docker Hub: publish exact scanned images
Use full Git SHA tags; GitHub Secrets
Pull published SHA images → fresh kind
Wait for rollout; Ingress UI / API smoke
Local profile uses real corpus + host Ollama.
No real Secret committed in Git
CACHE / SESSION RULES: sessions retain up to 6 turns (TTL 1800s); semantic cache TTL 3600s; never cache abstentions, fallbacks or follow-ups.
ACTUAL REVIEW SETTING: required approvals = 0 at Jibran's request. The assignment's one independent approval criterion remains unmet.
Editable source: docs/diagrams/complete-workflow.mmd | Indexer and API share the embedding pin; generation remains outside the API pods.
